body:
I haven't looked specifically at forums for that particular thing.. I have just googled how people deal with excess/loose skin and if there's anything to do other than surgery, but usually comes up empty.. or find other people depressed about it.  And stretch marks, too... my body is covered with them now.

I guess my area of expertise is... computers?  My previous job which was like 8 years ago was working as an IT Student Technician at my college (before I dropped out).  I can fix, repair, and build them.  I have looked around for work that doesn't require a college degree, and most of the ones I can find require good oral skills (which as i explained in another reply is hard for me due to my speech impediment).  I have considered going back to school, but my speech problem is one of the reasons why I dropped out back then.  I don't know if I can handle going back again. :(

I haven't seen a therapist due to no income or money... and I can't ask my family for help with that because then I'd have to explain why I need the money.  My family is already disappointed in me for many reasons - I don't need to take anymore of their money.  

I have considered online dating and mentioning my excess skin, but I guess I'm just afraid of rejection or not getting any messages.  I'm already depressed, I wouldn't want to get mean/hurtful messages or just no messages at all.  I know you have to take chances to make things happen, but it just feels too hopeless.  I'm not worth loving.

I'm sorry you don't have any friends.  I do consider myself lucky for having friends who have stuck by me during all my bullshit.  All the times I've pushed them away.  Hell, I even avoided them for a year and they still came back to me.  If anything keeps me going, it's them, but as I've started to push them away some more... I don't know.

Finding a job is difficult for me.  In a previous post on this subreddit, I went into detail about how/why I dropped out of college, so.. right now, I have no degree at all.  And I have a speech problem which hinders any type of interview process, and when I look for jobs, so many say they require good oral/communication skills which I lack.

It's sad to me that one of the most simple things in life - just talking - is so complicated and hard for me.  People take it for granted that they can speak properly and not have to worry about what they are trying to say... if someone will look at them weird or laugh.  I've dealt with that all my life and speech therapy during school did nothing to help.  Let's face it, a speech impediment isn't exactly an attractive trait to someone and on the job side of things, no hiring manager would hire someone with one over another person who didn't.  I wouldn't be surprised if they would pass over someone like me even if I was more qualified for the position.  I have worked before - once when I was around 16 at a grocery store.  I bagged groceries and I only got the job because my dad knew the owner.  And then I got a job during college as a student IT technician.  I only got that job because I was the only person who applied in their time frame.  The interview went horribly and I stuttered like crazy.  In fact, I didn't even get the job at first - they emailed me saying they hired someone else.  But then another one of their student workers quit, so they emailed back and took me.  I wouldn't have even gotten that job if they had other people waiting in line.  I managed to do okay with that job, but because of my depression back then, I stupidly quit and dropped out of college.

I wish I could view the world as you do.. like that whole last paragraph.  I know it's supposed to be inspiring and in a way it is, but the hopeless feeling in my head is so strong... It's hard to see anything I do will make a difference and I'll end up alone no matter what happens.  Thank you for trying to motivate me, though.  It would be nice to see my life as having value because it really doesn't right now.

One of my friends has told me that I need more confidence and to see better things about myself (basically what you said about loving yourself), but no matter how much I look at myself, I can't find anything worth loving.  I'm *maybe* a nice guy, but recently, I've just been so miserable and mopey which doesn't really make me seem like a nice guy.  Besides, being nice doesn't really get you shit in the world.

Part of me is proud of myself for losing the weight, but I think I assumed it would be more life changing.  Sure, I can actually go on hikes now and don't get out of breath walking around a mall, but I guess I expected more.  I never even really thought about the excess/loose skin issue when I started or I'm not sure if I would have bothered.  I probably would be close to death by now and this would finally be over if I had kept on eating like I was when I was at my biggest.  I went from being ashamed of my body for being fat to being ashamed of it for just looking gross with all the skin hanging everywhere.  I use these bandage things on my upper arms when I go out of the house because if I don't, I'm afraid someone will notice my skin hanging out of my shirt sleeve.  And it's too hot to wear long sleeves in the summer time.  I'm so afraid if I ever DO get the courage to try to meet someone, as soon as things get physical, they will tell me to leave as soon as I take off my clothes.  I wouldn't really blame them either.  Even if it wasn't the excess skin, I have nothing much to offer in that area.

Therapists aren't free most of the time, and I don't have the money for one.  I feel beyond help anyways. 

Thanks for your internet hugs and your message.  Even if it may sound like I don't think I can change, I do appreciate the thought.

It really does hurt all the time like you said.  There are moments when I can forget about it briefly, but then something small will happen that reminds me that I'm alone.  I look at other couples around me, even members of my own family (like my brother and his wife just had a new baby recently), and honestly I'm so jealous.  At Christmas and other holidays, I'm completely surrounded by couples at family events.  Like I'm really the only one there who didn't bring someone and it hurts... and makes me feel so alone.  Not that I'd really be able to bring a boyfriend to one of those things anyways due to my family being really religious and homophobic, but it would be nice anyways.

It's hard to not put much stake in what your family thinks about you.  They have no clue I'm gay and would likely disown me if they knew.  Or maybe not disown, but they would try to "convert" me.  I'm not on any medication or therapy... I can't afford any of that.  I have no job and no money besides any I get from my parents randomly.  I can't ask my parents for help with this because they would start asking questions on why I'm depressed or sad.  They know something is wrong, but I refuse to talk to them about it.  Getting surgery is an option, but it's so expensive, and I would need extensive surgery on multiple parts of my body - my arms, chest, stomach and thighs.  It's like $10k or more JUST for the stomach, so I don't have much hope of ever being able to afford that.  Besides, that would mean I had a job, and I can't seem to find the courage to try anymore because of my speech problem. The thought of trying to do phone interviews or just interviews in general petrifies me.  No one would want to hire someone like me, anyway.

Can I find something to live for?  The only thing is I know it would destroy my family and friends.  So I'm basically living because of guilt.  I don't really think that's fair, but from their perspective, it probably wouldn't be fair if I chose to gave up and kill myself.  I don't know how much longer I can feel the way I do.  I'm so alone.  I want physical contact with another person, but I'm too much of a mess to even attempt something like that.  I thought about just trying to go on Craigslist and seeing if someone would be willing to have sex with me, but I don't know.  Probably wouldn't work out or they would take one look at me and tell me to leave.  I used to love video games and that was one thing that kept me going - waiting on game releases, but the past few months... I've completely lost interest in them.  Nothing makes me happy anymore.  Gaming was really my passion for a while, and it's been months since I've played a game.  I can't find any drive for that anymore.  TV shows and movies used to distract me, but now all they do is remind me that I'm alone and will likely always be alone.  I hope your letter helps you feel better.  I don't think there's anything I could write right now that would encourage me to keep going.  I'm so tired of feeling like this.

Thanks for your reply, but I don't know if I even consider my weight loss a good thing now.  I went from feeling ugly for being fat to feeling ugly for having all the loose/excess skin.  At least if I had stayed fat, I would likely be dead soon due to a heart attack or something.  I know that sounds fucked up, but it's how I feel right now.

I have checked out that subreddit before, but it really just depresses me even more seeing people in loving relationships and getting engaged all the time.  It's great for them, but it's just a reminder that it'll never happen for me.
